extracted.intended_audience: people attending Laugh Factory San Diego shows and contributors submitting jokes/content
extracted.subtask_description: Venue page listing upcoming Laugh Factory San Diego shows, with venue policies, ticketing notes, payment/parking information, and an invitation to submit jokes/content for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-drink minimum purchase
rubrics_metrics.description: A two-drink minimum purchase per patron is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice appears alongside each listed show; it's a venue policy that applies to patrons attending shows. (Original wording: 'A two-drink minimum purchase per patron is required.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Vouchers not redeemable at the door
rubrics_metrics.description: Vouchers are not redeemable at the door.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated as a ticketing restriction for patrons; appears repeatedly with each show listing. (Original wording: 'Vouchers are not redeemable at the door.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Prices/performers/schedule subject to change
rubrics_metrics.description: Prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A standard disclaimer indicating show details may change without notice. (Original wording: 'Prices, performers, and schedule are subject to change.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Parking — valet service available
rubrics_metrics.description: VALET SERVICE IN FRONT OF THE CLUB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical information for attendees about on-site parking options. (Original wording: 'PARKING: VALET SERVICE IN FRONT OF THE CLUB.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted payment methods
rubrics_metrics.description: WE ACCEPT: CASH, CARDS , APPLE PAY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies forms of payment accepted by the venue for tickets/onsite purchases. (Original wording preserved.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Content submission invitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos to become an exclusive Laugh Factory member and have your content shared on our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Call-to-action for contributors; no detailed content standards listed on this page. The page also notes Facebook connection/privacy text: 'We'll never post to Facebook without your permission We will access Facebook to get and use your email address, friend list, interests, likes and public profile, which includes your name, profile picture, user ID, age range, gender, networks, language, country and your other public info.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright / reproduction prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: This website is protected by U.S. and International copyright laws. Reproduction and distribution of content, with or without modification, without written permission of Laugh Factory Inc., is prohibited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal notice about proprietary rights in site content, trademarks, and media. (Original wording preserved.)
